access_links.label: KiwiRail Bridges (WFS)
access_links.note: Alternate-format item metadata agrees on publisher and resource scope. Distribution content was not downloaded or compared.

access_note: Public metadata was readable without authentication. Data queries, download access and service operation were not tested. The source states Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, with accuracy and completeness caveats.
description: KiwiRail represents rail bridges as single polylines along the Main Left or Up Main track centreline. Attributes include bridge number, line name, bridge type, Maximo asset identifier and midpoint coordinates. The stated spatial accuracy is about 0.5 m. Road-over-rail bridges, culverts, footbridges, subways and stock crossings are excluded. Inclusion does not necessarily establish KiwiRail ownership. Feature-service and WFS items describe the same bridge resource and are retained as access alternatives. Coverage is New Zealand. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service and alternate item listings. Licence and cost: The source states Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, with accuracy and completeness caveats. Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides mapped infrastructure or service inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing KiwiRail network-risk and freight-disruption layers.
